Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring paid leave for state employees engaged in search and rescue activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to search and rescue volunteers; and adding a newsection to chapter 41.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An agency shall grant leave with pay to an employee engaged involunteer search and rescue activities, as defined in RCW 38.52.010.
